title: 第5章 天灵体第6章 秦家出龙
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“我上一辈子，虽然不重视煅炼肉体，但是，好奇之下，也收集了不少高明的煅体法诀。
我该修炼哪一种好呢。”
叶云飞在脑海之中，回忆着上一辈子，所收集的煅体法诀。
“天魔融血煅体诀！”
蓦地，叶云飞脸上露出惊喜之色。
“这一门煅体法诀，是属于真魔族的传承法诀，不但进展快速，而且威力霸道。
更重要的是，没有入门条件，境界弱小的武者，也可以修炼！
接下来，我要应付秦家和施家的报复。
这一门速成的煅体法诀，最适合我。
好，就它了！”
叶云飞作出了决定。
“修炼天魔融血煅体诀，需要灵药的辅助，还需要采集大量的生灵血脉精华。
采购灵药，需要大量的灵晶石，这个，并不难。
至于生灵的血脉精华，我总不能去杀人吧，看来，只有一个选择，那就是离圆月城不远的天兽森林了。
天兽森林中，有大量的妖魔兽，妖魔兽的血脉精华，最适合用来修炼天魔融血煅体诀了。”
叶云飞心中，已有了具体的计划。
“同时，我的灵气境界太低了，也要抓紧时间，提升上去。”
房间内，叶云飞开始修炼九阳经。
圆月城。
施家。

一间豪华宽阔的大厅之中。
啪！
一个黄袍中年男子，满脸怒色，一掌把身旁的一张矮茶几，震成粉碎，化成漫天飘浮的粉尘。
这张矮茶几是用有名的黑铁木制造而成的，比精铁还要坚硬得多，居然被这个中年男子，一掌震碎。
可想而知，这个中年男子的掌力，有多么的可怕。
“叶云飞这个废物，居然敢当众写下休书，休掉我的女儿！
太可恨了！”
中年男子气得脸容扭曲，怒火冲天。
他就是施家的家主，施天源！
“父亲，那个叶云飞，当众侮辱于我，让我丢尽了脸，这个仇，一定要报！”
施小蝶也站在大厅之中，抽抽泣泣，哭得花容失色。
她一回到家，就立即找到施天源哭诉。
“哼，那个废物，敢如此辱我施家，必死无疑！
不过，我的目标，并不是区区一个叶云飞。
我的目标，是灭掉整个叶家，吞并叶家所有的产业！
今年的四族夺矿大赛，日子已经定下来了，在十天之后。
这是一个机会！
等会，我会亲自去一趟秦家，找秦家的家主详谈。
content_en:
"Although I didn't pay much attention to body tempering in my previous life, out of curiosity, I also collected many brilliant body tempering techniques.
Which one should I practice? "
In Ye Yunfei's mind, he recalled the body-forging techniques he had collected in his previous life.
"The Heavenly Demon's Blood Melting Body Forging Technique!"
Suddenly, a look of surprise appeared on Ye Yunfei's face.
"This body-forging technique is an inherited technique belonging to the true demon clan. It not only makes rapid progress, but is also overbearingly powerful.
What's more important is that there are no entry requirements, and even weak warriors can practice!
Next, I have to deal with the revenge of the Qin family and the Shi family.
This quick method of forging the body is the most suitable for me.
OK, that’s it! "
Ye Yunfei made a decision.
“Practice the Heavenly Demon’s Blood Fusion and Body Forging Technique, which requires the assistance of elixirs and the collection of a large amount of living blood essence.
Purchasing elixirs requires a large amount of spiritual crystals, which is not difficult.
As for the blood essence of living beings, I can't kill people. It seems that there is only one choice, and that is the Forest of Heavenly Beasts not far from Yuanyue City.
There are a large number of demonic beasts in the Heavenly Beast Forest, and the blood essence of the demonic beasts is most suitable for practicing the Heavenly Demon Blood Melting Body Forging Technique. "
Ye Yunfei already had a specific plan in mind.
"At the same time, my spiritual energy level is too low, so I must seize the time to improve it."
In the room, Ye Yunfei began to practice the Nine Yang Sutra.
Full Moon City.
Shi family.
In a luxurious and spacious hall.
Snap!
A middle-aged man in a yellow robe, with an angry look on his face, shattered a low coffee table next to him with one palm, turning it into dust floating in the sky.
This short coffee table is made of the famous black iron wood, which is much harder than fine iron. It was shattered by this middle-aged man's palm.
One can imagine how terrifying this middle-aged man's palm power is.
"Ye Yunfei, this loser, actually dared to write a letter of divorce and divorce my daughter in public!
How hateful! "
The middle-aged man's face was distorted with anger, and he was furious.
He is the head of the Shi family, Shi Tianyuan!
"Father, that Ye Yunfei insulted me in public and made me lose face. This revenge must be avenged!"
Shi Xiaodie also stood in the hall, sobbing and crying until her face turned pale.
As soon as she returned home, she immediately found Shi Tianyuan and cried.
"Hmph, that loser dares to humiliate my Shi family like this, and he will definitely die!
However, my goal is not just Ye Yunfei.
My goal is to destroy the entire Ye family and annex all the Ye family's properties!
This year's four-tribe mine competition has been set for ten days.
This is an opportunity!
Later, I will go to the Qin family in person and talk to the head of the Qin family in detail.
